item.title: Alex's teaser trailer features some fun references and Easter eggs for Street Fighter 3 and Final Fight that you may have missed
item.description: <p>Although his release date is still likely months away, fans finally got a chance to see Alex in motion inside <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a>'s engine and not just in artwork.</p> <p>Capcom dropped <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/08/alex-teaser-trailer-sf6/">Alex's teaser trailer for Street Fighter 6</a> last night, and there was a loving amount of attention to detail put into the video aimed at longtime fans.</p>

item.title: Awesome mod seemingly adds obscure character from Red Earth into Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3
